name: Advanced Health Limited
summary: Advanced Health Limited, an investment holding company, provides short-procedure surgical facilities and services in day hospitals in South Africa and Australia. It offers surgical procedure services in the areas of knee, shoulder, elbow, hand, eye, skin, spine, cosmetic, gynecology, urology, dermatology, maxillofacial and dental, ophthalmology, orthopedic, and general surgery, as well as ear, nose, and throat. The company also owns and operates day hospitals in Australia and South Africa. Advanced Health Limited was founded in 2013 and is based in Pretoria, South Africa.
